checkpoint: P2-E1 original-scope readiness and retained-evidence review
reviewed_scope: Original six work items, six acceptance criteria and five deliverables; current known-route synthetic advisory evidence only

items.description: Energy ownership, equations, units and assumptions documented
Reference and route-dependent forecasts with immutable derived records
Route energy, final charge, conditional time/range, reserve and station reachability
Explicit uncertainty assumptions, observed coverage and width limits
Whole-mission train/validation/held-out separation and designated-data fitting
Forecast display includes input age, horizon, versions, assumptions, uncertainty and explanations
Numerical energy balance, bounds, limiting cases and refinement
Selected isolated worker denies private plant/truth access; trusted host/controller boundary remains explicit
Frozen known-route cutoff study reports every regime/count/failure against unchanged criteria
Degraded/unavailable inputs and visible interface behavior; explicit missing/out-of-domain browser assertions still needed
Identical calculation inputs/settings reproduce outputs in the declared scope
Input lineage, model/uncertainty identity and separate immutable observations
Current model cards distinguish foundation, calibrated study and product integration
Actual complete dataset manifests and exact file inventories retained
Asset-scoped forecast read API exists for the documented route/cutoff
Private Phase 2 evidence is present and integrity verified; this is not all-requirements completion

open_gaps.description: Station locations exist, but no station-specific reachability calculation or verified road approach exists
open_gaps.closure: Provide a read-only station assessment bound to an explicit valid road approach and assumed forward plan; report reachable/reserve-shortfall/unavailable with station and input lineage. Verify route, energy and failure cases. Do not infer reachability from straight-line distance or relabel end-of-route evaluation as station-arrival accuracy.

open_gaps.description: Input age, explicit forward horizon, conditional driving range/time and concrete assumptions are not fully presented
open_gaps.closure: Expose those quantities from traceable stored/derived inputs with correct wall/simulation time and units; distinguish the conditional recent-consumption reference from the route model. Show unavailable values honestly and preserve old records and frozen model/targets.

open_gaps.description: Missing and out-of-domain UI states have logic/unit/API coverage but lack explicit assertions in the actual Energy browser test
open_gaps.closure: Extend the small controlled integration with separate missing-required-input and unsupported-domain browser cases, plus recovery and scope checks. Requalify affected behavior once after changes stabilize; do not repeat fleet/soak or the consumed held-out study.

shared_checks.scope: Audit/checklist/test changes; product and model implementation unchanged. Not an application acceptance rerun.
